quarterly_data.signal: Customer Amazon: ArcelorMittal 6-K (press release) - Amazon entered into a multi-year Supply Framework Agreement with ArcelorMittal for the supply of structural steel across Europe and the United Kingdom, under which ArcelorMittal will supply lower-carbon XCarb steel for use in Amazon operations facilities and AWS data centres.

Supplier Amazon Web Services: ArcelorMittal 6-K - ArcelorMittal announced a strategic collaboration with AWS to accelerate industrial automation across its global operations, converging some of its operational and information technology on AWS infrastructure and deploying AI at the point of production (predictive maintenance, computer-vision quality control, process optimisation, digital twins); AWS will also deliver an education programme for its workforce.
